title: Practice 10: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Who's singing with him now?
exercises.why: **петь → поёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is a bad influence.
exercises.why: **оказывать → оказывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The apple tree has a beautiful blossom.
exercises.why: **цвести → цветёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: В фильме ___ (прослеживаться) основные вехи биографии учёного.
exercises.prompt: The film traces the main milestones in the life of the scientist.
exercises.why: **прослеживаться → прослеживаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I don't get enough sleep at night.
exercises.why: **высыпаться → высыпаюсь** — present-type form, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: This flower spreads its petals at night.
exercises.why: **распускаться → распускается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: This rule applies to all cases.
exercises.why: **применяться → применяется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: My wife spends too much money on herself.
exercises.why: **тратиться → тратится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I said I'd figure it out.
exercises.why: **разузнавать → разузнаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Food is digested in the stomach.
exercises.why: **перевариваться → переваривается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Taxes consist of direct taxes and indirect ones.
exercises.why: **делиться → делятся** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: They're just jealous that we're having fun.
exercises.why: **веселиться → веселимся** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -им belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: What time does the next bus leave?
exercises.why: **отъезжать → отъезжает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: His son is serving his sentence.
exercises.why: **чалиться → чалится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: My American friend is learning Palauan.
exercises.why: **учить → учит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Are you growing a beard?
exercises.why: **отращивать → отращиваете** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Калькулятор, который я купил, не ___ (поддерживать) мнимые числа.
exercises.prompt: The calculator I bought does not support imaginary numbers.
exercises.why: **поддерживать → поддерживает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Не материальные, а духовные вещи ___ (определять) нашу жизнь.
exercises.prompt: Not material, but spiritual things determine our life.
exercises.why: **определять → определяют** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Благодаря цифровой фотографии никто, похоже, уже не ___ (отдавать) плёнку на проявку.
exercises.prompt: Thanks to digital photography it seems that no one has their film developed anymore.
exercises.why: **отдавать → отдаёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Jet planes fly much faster than propeller planes.
exercises.why: **летать → летают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
